section_1_test_metadata.scenario_method: EP01 V4-LITE shot-grammar structured batch with scenario/character field separation

scenario_character_separation.observation: Strict scenario/character field separation held across all 25 shots. Scenario fields stayed location-atmosphere-action only; character fields carried visible entity descriptions only.
scenario_character_separation.impact: Reduced character identity bleed and improved Gonegi/Gamja readability versus mixed-field prompts.

character_dna_stability.observation: Character-simple-v1 injection remained stable for hair, clothing silhouette, and age read across domestic, lane, and harbor shots.
character_dna_stability.impact: Confirmed production-safe baseline for Music Drama Image App batches without full Character DNA expansion.

gonegi_consistency.observation: Gonegi facial identity, henley-suspenders costume cluster, and boy-scale proportions remained recognizable in 22 of 25 shots.
gonegi_consistency.impact: Protagonist anchor reliable for lyric-aligned still sequences.

gamja_consistency.observation: Gamja companion scale, fur tone, and proximity framing remained stable in companion-forward and domestic shots.
gamja_consistency.impact: Validates MDG companion continuity rules and RKB-001 companion finding at 25-shot scale.

overall_visual_quality.observation: Warm Mediterranean daily-life mood, readable compositions, and low catastrophic anatomy failure rate across the batch.
overall_visual_quality.impact: Batch suitable as first MDG v1 shot-grammar validation success for still-image Music Drama.

mdg_v1_compatibility.observation: MDG shot patterns, beat-linked emotional states, motifs, and density limits were consumable without adapter or grammar modification.
mdg_v1_compatibility.impact: Music Drama Grammar Core + Image Adapter stack validated as operational input layer for Image App tests.

location_drift.description: Same narrative location (bedroom, bakery threshold, harbor bench) shifted architecture, wall layout, or landmark placement between adjacent shots.
example_cases: Bedroom window wall moved between intro and bridge quiet shots
Harbor bench orientation flipped between pre-chorus harbor watch shots
Bakery counter depth changed between verse family breakfast stills
location_drift.production_risk: Breaks multi-shot music-video spatial continuity and viewer place memory.

lighting_drift.description: Time-of-day and key-light direction inconsistent within the same time cluster (sunrise, early morning, golden hour).
example_cases: Sunrise cool fill became warm overhead in consecutive domestic shots
Harbor rim-light direction reversed between two wonder-state frames
Interior bakery glow intensity jumped without narrative time advance
lighting_drift.production_risk: Undermines lyric-time alignment and sequential believability.

scene_mutation.description: Props, furniture, and background layout changed between shots intended to share one scene anchor.
example_cases: Table setting changed between two family breakfast frames
Rooftop parapet detail appeared/disappeared in hilltop lunch pair
Lane staircase railing style varied in street passage sequence
scene_mutation.production_risk: Creates subtle continuity errors visible in video-style sequencing.

environment_inconsistency.description: Harbor-village atmosphere remained warm overall but micro-environment cues (fog, sea color, cobble wear) varied without weather narrative.
example_cases: Sea horizon color shifted from slate-blue to emerald between harbor shots
Cobblestone texture density changed in lane vs harbor edge without relocation
Background hillside detail density inconsistent in wide frames
environment_inconsistency.production_risk: Weakens world-bible trust even when character identity stays strong.

weak_emotional_expression.description: Faces and body language often read neutral-calm rather than MDG target emotions (comfort, wonder, quiet hope).
example_cases: Chorus hope beat read as generic smile without forward-looking residue
Bridge quiet reflection lacked softened stillness in gaze/posture
Pre-chorus wonder under-expressed in harbor watch framing
weak_emotional_expression.production_risk: Limits narrative emotional delivery required for ballad and healing MV formats.

wide_shots.future_use_recommendation: USE_WITH_LOCATION_DNA — strong atmosphere, weak spatial lock

medium_shots.future_use_recommendation: PRIMARY_WORKHORSE — best balance of character readability and scene context

close_shots.future_use_recommendation: STRONG_FOR_CHARACTER_ANCHOR — prioritize for consistency recovery slots

reaction_shots.future_use_recommendation: USE_SPARINGLY_UNTIL_EMOTION_DNA — expression drift limits lyric beats

insert_shots.future_use_recommendation: SAFE_FOR_MOTIF_BRIDGE — bread, window, tea motif inserts stable; avoid complex hands

instrumental_music_video.reason: Atmosphere-forward sequencing tolerates softer acting; location/lighting drift is the main blocker.

healing_music_video.reason: Warm daily-life tone, Gamja companion beats, and calm emotional baseline align strongly with EP01 grammar.

travel_music_video.reason: Location drift and environment inconsistency reduce geographic continuity needed for travel-style cuts.

ambient_music_video.reason: Mediterranean mood and low narrative pressure match current system strengths.

lyric_ballad_music_video.reason: Requires stable emotional acting and lighting-time fidelity not yet met without Emotion DNA and Lighting DNA.

current_system_strength.world_atmosphere: Mediterranean harbor-town warmth and music-drama mood read clearly across the 25-shot batch.
current_system_strength.character_consistency: Gonegi and Gamja identity stability confirmed at scale with field separation and MDG v1 grammar.
current_system_strength.visual_warmth: Domestic and harbor stills deliver lyric-friendly warmth suitable for healing and ambient MV directions.

current_system_weakness.location_persistence: No Location DNA layer; same-scene architectural drift is the primary continuity failure.
current_system_weakness.lighting_persistence: No Lighting DNA layer; time-cluster lighting does not hold across adjacent shots.
current_system_weakness.emotion_acting: Facial and body-language expression under-delivers MDG emotional targets.
current_system_weakness.narrative_emotional_delivery: Sequential emotional progression readable in grammar but weak in rendered expression for ballad-style MV.

ranked_priorities.rationale: Highest-severity failure cluster (location_drift, scene_mutation) blocking multi-shot continuity.
Second-highest drift source; required for time-cluster and lyric-time alignment.
Needed to close weak_emotional_expression gap for ballad and reaction-heavy shots.
Near-ready format; validate after Location and Lighting DNA reduce drift.
Deferred until Emotion DNA and lighting persistence improve narrative delivery.
